name: Bloom
source:
Step into the fantastic world of Feldoria and follow our protagonist, Astra, as she works on a development plan for Cafe Bloom (and maybe falls in love along the way)!

[From [url=https://nightlightwrks.itch.io/bloom-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
走進費爾多里亞的奇幻世界，跟隨主角阿斯特拉一起為繁花咖啡館制定發展計劃（說不定她還會在途中墜入愛河）！
